note: Areas that were searched for RV repair businesses and found to have none. This is EVIDENCE, NOT A SUPPRESSION LIST: nothing here removes a gap from the coverage instrument. The gap keeps appearing, and this file is what stops the next pass spending a full research budget rediscovering the same emptiness. Add an entry when a pass concludes, never to make a number look better.

texas.area: Zapata County and Starr County, the western Rio Grande Valley
texas.cost: one research pass, about 1.6 million tokens, for a null result
texas.what_was_found: No business in either county has a live own website carrying RV-repair evidence, which is the site's standard. Roughly forty others were rejected across five reasons: general auto, collision, tyre and muffler shops; RV and mobile-home PARKS that directories miscategorise as RV repair; truck and diesel; dispatch networks; and providers out of the area.
texas.the_one_near_miss: Falcon RV Repair, Rio Grande City, is a genuine dedicated RV repair business, and its own site was a Google-hosted page that now returns 404. If it gets a live site it is this area's one real listing.
texas.nearest_real_capacity: Ron Hoover RV and Marine, Laredo, about 50 miles west of Zapata, plus the listed Hidalgo County mobile technicians.
texas.conclusion: This area has no RV repair coverage because it has no provider, which is a different fact from a missing listing, and the directory cannot fix it by adding rows.

california.area: Plumas County, the Quincy and East Quincy corridor
california.cost: one reconnaissance search, not a full research pass
california.what_was_found: No RV repair business with its own website. The results are RV PARKS (Pioneer RV Park and River Ranch RV Park), which the repair-only rule excludes; six general automotive shops (Dan The Mobile Man, Hi-Tech Frame & Finish, Les Schwab, Curran Tire Center, Frank's Garage, John's Automotive Electrical), which are not RV-specific; and two dispatch networks (Interstate Fleet Services and Road Rescue Network) that dominate the results for every town and are excluded as lead-generation rather than a real business.
california.conclusion: No admissible provider. This is a genuine absence of RV repair coverage rather than a missing listing, and unlike the western Rio Grande Valley it was established in one search rather than a full pass, which is the argument for reconnaissance before commissioning research.

newmexico.what_was_found: No RV repair business with its own website. districtofcolumbia.cost: one research pass, for a null result
districtofcolumbia.what_was_found: No DC-based business repairs RVs. DC Mobile Truck Repair is a semi-truck service that mentions RV only in one boilerplate line; Mobile Mechanic Washington DC describes cars, trucks and vans and never an RV; RV Associates resolves to a business-consulting site; RV General Auto Repair and RV Standifer have no website to check. Every other candidate was either a truck or auto shop, or a Maryland or Virginia business that merely serves DC and belongs to its own state's file (Avenue Mobile Services, Road Ready RV & Trailer Services, Eyre HD, Fixed It! and others). The directory lists repair businesses a reader can take a coach to, so DC carries no page rather than an empty one. Revisit if a DC-based RV repair business appears.

illinois.area: Champaign, Urbana and the east-central corridor, IL
illinois.cost: one research pass, for a null result
illinois.what_was_found: Real RV businesses exist here and cannot be listed, because none has its own website: Greg's Truck Tire & Auto (Champaign), R and S RV (Mahomet), Down To Earth Mobile RV (Mahomet). The 'mobile RV repair in Champaign' pages that search returns are lead-gen and dispatch networks (Road Rescue Network, Interstate Fleet Services, RV Help, stevethemechanic), which the directory excludes. Ty's ruling, 2026-10-04: a business with no web presence cannot be verified, so it is excluded and can add itself through the claim form. This area is therefore a gap BY RULE, not an unfinished search, and should not be re-researched.

hawaii.area: Hawaii, statewide (Oahu, Maui, the Big Island, Kauai, Molokai, Lanai)
hawaii.cost: one thorough research pass across all six islands, for a null result
hawaii.why_empty: no qualifying business with its own website
hawaii.what_was_found: Hawaii has almost no dedicated RV repair. The entire search space is national mobile-dispatch networks (Road Rescue Network, Interstate Fleet Services, A1 RV Repair, Coast to Coast) and directory pages, all excluded by rule. The near-misses, each failing a stated rule rather than being absent: R V Tech Automotive (Pearl City) and Recreational Vehicles of HI (Kailua-Kona) are real RV-sounding businesses with NO OWN WEBSITE; Mobile Mechanic Honolulu's advertised domain does not resolve; Hawaii Surf Campers (Wahiawa) repairs campervans but publishes no phone; Trailers By Sam (Kaneohe) is marine trailer; 808 Diesel Doc is diesel-led; Island RV is dealer-only; Fibrenew Hawaii is interior restoration only; Sunmasters Hawaii is window tinting, mis-tagged as RV service by a directory. Ty's ruling, 2026-10-04: a business with no web presence cannot be verified, so it is excluded and can add itself through the claim form. **This state is a gap BY RULE, not an unfinished search.** The one thing that would change it is a phone-vetting pass, which is a human task, not a search.
